Name: Victorian Farm Buildings
Author: BethKitten
Description:
Give your farm a Victorian style. With cream colored buildings accented with colored trim each building has it's own unique appeal. The farmhouse is outfitted with a bay window.  For now, this mod is only for mobile users. A content patcher version will be released once I get the cabins done.To use on mobile, unpack the zip file and place the xnb files in your CustomLocalization folder under Content -->Buildings. You may need to create the Buildings folder. This a way to use xnb mods without touching the original game files. Your Mod folder should look like this when installed correctly:
Mods --> CustomLocalization --> Content --> Buildings --> Barn.xnb, Coop.xnb(etc)

Content Patcher version now available.  This version is for players that use Stardew Valley 1.5. or higher only.  

Mods included in pictures:

DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour by Daisy
Victorian Craftables by Hadi
Old Tractor by Gwen by Gwen
Garden Pots by BethKitten
Victorian Tractor Shed by BethKitten

Do not edit or repost without permission.
